scientific_limitations.domain: nonempty finite simple undirected loopless graphs with pure adjacency and equality
exclusions: FO with at least three variables
scientific_limitations.finite_computation: All unlabeled graphs through seven vertices corroborate the theorem; this finite experiment is not its infinite proof.
scientific_limitations.logic: counting-free FO with two reusable variables, unrestricted quantifier depth
scientific_limitations.nonuniqueness: A minimum-order representative need not be unique; the P4 core is a canonical chosen representative.
scientific_limitations.priority: Novelty is assessed relative to inspected literature. A general result may subsume the normal form, and complete primary text of Grädel–Otto 1999 was not accessed.

title: Universal–isolated peeling classifies two-variable theories of finite graphs
